# Stagehands
Should you ever find yourself having missed round start, dead, or wanting a change of pace, the theater manager can let you become a stagehand for the duration of the round.
Stagehands work behind the scene of the round to influence events and react to the actor’s moves. While a stagehand, you can fly around and spectate the round, invisible to everyone currently alive. You also have a list of warp locations, that also lets you see the objectives of everyone.
Additionally, above the usual text chat you get access to a stagehand exclusive chat, and are able to discuss anything you like.
## Events Random events aren’t all that random. When one is about to occur, a sound will play with vote appearing above the chat box. You can vote as much as you like on as many options, and each vote will make a result more likely to occur.
Some events may have additional votes if they win, such as meteors allowing you to direct where they come from or a gas leaks allowing you to pick a location and a gas from a list.
## Cheers Stagehands also get an action to cheer or boo, playing a sound effect all nearby stagehands can hear. Sometimes players nearby will hear them too!
## Tragedians and You The Tragedian secret identity has some power over the stagehands, as stagehands have over them. They are given an objective to preform a certain theme, and at their time of death a vote is held between all stagehands on if they preformed it well.
All tragedians also have an ability to call stagehands to their location, to ensure they have an audience spectating their acting. Feel free to use any cheers as they act, as they can always hear them!
